source: Platform hunt for the 16 'missing' rows of fanlist_vertical_favourites_2026-08-13.json
method: Web search restricted to the platform domains themselves (allowed_domains), not to aggregators. Third-party databases that turned up in results - shortdramadb.com, dramaglance.com, shortdramacast.com - were NOT used as evidence: shortdramadb is the same refusal call already recorded for verticaldrama.tv.
caption_rule: NO SYNOPSIS TEXT WAS TAKEN FROM ANY RESULT. Platform, watch link, episode count and cast names only. Every caption for these titles must still be written from scratch before the title can count as complete.
note_on_status: confirmed = a watch/series page on the platform's OWN domain names the exact title. probable = the platform's own fandom blog carries dedicated articles about the exact title but no watch page was found. near_match = a DIFFERENT title that resembles this one; a human ruling, never an auto-merge.

corrections_to_the_fanlist.action: Drop from the import queue. The queue is 15, not 16.
